general.description: Manage your Dome account, plan and profile on this device.
general.start: Work locally without an account. Connect one when you need cloud services.

appearance.description: Choose how Dome looks and restore your panel layout.
appearance.start: Select a theme; it applies immediately.

language.description: Change the language of menus, guides and settings.
language.start: Choose a language. Your document content stays unchanged.

features.description: Choose which sections appear in Dome for the way you work.
features.start: Choose a mode or enable individual sections. Modes are not paid plans.

ai.description: Connect the AI Many will use and configure search, voice and context.
ai.start: Start with Conversation. The other tabs are optional and configured separately.

kb_llm.description: Choose how Many organizes knowledge and when it updates it.
kb_llm.start: Review the sources and update policy first.

indexing.description: Prepare your documents so they can be found by meaning.
indexing.start: Set up a model in AI → Document search, then check the index status.

cloud.description: Connect Google Drive to access your files from Dome.
cloud.start: Add a Google account. This is separate from syncing Dome between devices.

calendar.description: Connect your calendars and choose how to receive reminders.
calendar.start: Connect Google Calendar, then adjust synchronization and notifications.

email.description: Add accounts to read and work with email in Dome.
email.start: Choose your provider. Use manual setup only when you need IMAP and SMTP.

social.description: Connect your profiles and manage publishing tools.
social.start: Add an account; check cloud access if you want to sync it.

dome_sync.description: Bring supported Dome data to your other devices.
dome_sync.start: Connect your account and check that your plan includes the sync you need.

remote_many.description: Link another device to use Many while this computer is available.
remote_many.start: Enable access and pair only your own devices.

browser_extension.description: Save pages and browser content to your Dome library.
browser_extension.start: Install the extension and check that it can connect to this app.

skills.description: Add skills: reusable instructions for specific tasks.
skills.start: Install a skill from the store or import one you already have.

plugins.description: Extend Dome with additional tools and sections.
plugins.start: Review what each plugin does before installing or enabling it.

mcp.description: Connect external tools that Many can use.
mcp.start: Add an MCP server using the connection details supplied by the tool.

dome_mcp.description: Let other AI apps access Dome through MCP.
dome_mcp.start: Enable the server and copy its configuration into the app you want to connect.

advanced.description: Update Dome, configure saving and export or import your data.
advanced.start: Export a copy before importing data.

research.description: Configure Many’s sources, check their access and control acquisition costs. Agent-Reach capabilities adapted to Dome.
research.start: Choose a source, review its route and test an operation. Paid providers need a key and explicit permission.

memory.description: Review personal memories, domain context and recent logs.
memory.start: Disabling memory excludes personal memories from new context and prevents automatic writes on every surface. SOUL, project instructions and conversation history remain available. Manual editing is always available.

ai.chat: The provider is the service that answers Many. Selecting it here does not activate it until you save.
ai.embeddings: This model prepares document representations for search by meaning. It is configured separately from conversation.
ai.transcription: Choose how to turn audio into text and whether to add a summary. Permissions are requested when needed.
ai.tools: Set up the web search sources that Many can consult.
ai.context: Choose the information Many receives and how it handles long conversations.
ai.cloud: You need an API key from {{provider}}. Usage is billed by that provider, separately from your Dome account.
ai.subscription: Connect this provider’s account and choose an available model. This connection is separate from your Dome account.
ai.local: Run the model server and check its address. A Dome account is not required.
ai.key_hint: Paste this provider’s key. Never use your password here.
ai.test_hint: Checking saves and activates this provider. It may consume a small amount of usage.
ai.load_error: Could not load the configuration. Reopen this section to try again.
ai.profile_hint: This profile is saved on this device. Changing this email does not change your account sign-in email.
ai.save_error: Could not save changes. Please try again.
